categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Per definition, PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes or template logic are mining rather than IPC unless they touch IPC infrastructure itself.
categories.rationale: Non-member; changes mining interface method behavior and argument validation rather than IPC transport or serialization infrastructure.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies the `interfaces::Mining` methods WaitTipChanged and WaitAndCreateNewBlock.
categories.rationale: Prevents debug assertion aborts and unintended wait_until delays caused by negative or NaN timeout arguments passed over the mining interface. As noted in the description, no current client is known to pass these values (e.g., sv2-tp enforces positive timeouts), making this defensive input hardening.
